8,805 likes, 179 comments - passionpassport on April 28, 2022: "Visit Moraine Lake, nestled in the striking Valley of the Ten Peaks, Once featured on the back of Canada's twenty dollar bill. With vivid turquoise waters set against a backdrop of glaciers it is no wonder Lake Louise and Moraine Lake are among the most popular destinations in the Canadian Rockies. As with many bucket list Rockies destinations, exploring beyond the main viewpoints will lead to unique and secluded experiences.⁠
⁠
📸 @argenel⁠
#passionpassport #banff #lakemoraine".

posts.meta_description:
4,701 likes, 45 comments - passionpassport on April 24, 2022: "Japan’s Art Islands: Naoshima, Teshima, Inujima⁠
⁠
Japan’s predominant religion is Shintoism. One affirmation is to hold nature sacred. This sensitivity to, and honoring of, the natural environment is evidenced when you walk in and around the elegant spaces and traverse the open-air gallery formed by the art islands.⁠
⁠
This building resembles the moment a water droplet lands on a solid surface- a true architectural wonder and collaboration between Japanese sculptor Rei Naito and architect Ryue Nishizawa. For all of our tips & tricks for a visit to these three art islands check out our guide linked in bio!⁠
⁠
#passionpassport #japan".

1,793 likes, 44 comments - passionpassport on April 22, 2022: "Setting the scene: it’s early 2020, just a couple of weeks before the world shut down. Our team landed in Rio and immersed ourselves in the pure magic of Carnaval.

In the months leading up to this event, we had partnered with our friends at @americanair and held a contest for two community members to enjoy this unforgettable experience. This video shares the story of our contest winner, Josh Alvarez, who traveled to Brazil and paid tribute to his late father.

As Carnaval kicks off again this week, we look back at these memories fondly and look forward to being back together. 

#MoreThanCarnaval

NB: masks are not used in this video as this was shot prior to the pandemic and mask mandates.".

4,741 likes, 57 comments - passionpassport on April 20, 2022: "A stroll down the largest old town in Europe means crossing over two thousand years of history. With a strong past dating back to the ancient Greek city Neapolis, it is no surprise to see strong traditions within Naples to this day. The personality and spirit of Naples is one you must experience to truly understand. For a true glimpse into authentic Italian culture Naples is the destination for you. ⁠
⁠
📸 @takkeb⁠
⁠
#passionpassport #naples #italy".

8,737 likes, 85 comments - passionpassport on April 18, 2022: "Intended to resemble a bright warm forest, Munich’s Municipal Law Library is one of the most beautiful in the world. The rather small library is located within the city’s new Town Hall, which was built between 1867 and 1908. ⁠
⁠
Pro trip from @themodernleper ⤵️⁠
Open to the public, be sure to visit early or join the tours through town hall. ⁠
⁠
📸 @themodernleper⁠
#passionpassport #germany".

3,289 likes, 27 comments - passionpassport on April 16, 2022: "POV: You are watching the sunrise as you cruise down the Nile River 🇪🇬⁠
⁠
@Dreamexplorers_ shared their journey from Luxor to Aswan with us. If you are looking to truly experience Egyptian culture and dive into the country's ancient history, bypass the planes and embark on one of these multi day cruises down the Nile. "This is definitely an experience that we cherish. It’s not everyday you can say that you did a cruise on the biggest river of the world."⁠
⁠
📸 @Dreamexplorers_⁠
#passionpassport #egypt".

3,476 likes, 34 comments - passionpassport on April 14, 2022: "Cusco Off the Beaten Path with @jpwilliamsmedia 

“For countless reasons Peru is one of the most diverse, culturally rich countries in the world. Machu Picchu is just as magical as it seems, but there is so much more to this country and the region of Cusco than just one archeological site.” 

If you are eager to embark off the beaten path, checkout these spots so you too can experience more to Machu Picchu 🇵🇪 

📍Salineras de Maras
📍Moray Cuzco 
📍Urubamba
📍Valle Sagrado de los Incas
📍Ollantaytambo 

📸 @jpwilliamsmedia 

#passionpassport #peru #machupicchu".

6,611 likes, 57 comments - passionpassport on April 12, 2022: "9 of the Best Road Trip Routes in the World 🗺 

Near or far, long or short, road trips are often the most satisfying of journeys. By physically driving the distance between places you get to know the landscapes of the world more intimately than if you had taken a plane. From Banff to Australia & everywhere in between- if you’re itching to get behind the wheel, check out these nine incredible road-trip locations around the world. Link in bio!

📸@jolelewis @imlukemackenzie @alicethieu @kymellis 

#passionpassport #roadtrip #travel".

posts.meta_description:
6,089 likes, 44 comments - passionpassport on April 11, 2022: "📍Travel to Ninh Bình with @iamdavidoliveirac ⁠
⁠
"This was my second time in Vietnam so I decided to avoid the busy, always bubbling city of Hanoi. Just two hours away, you can find Ninh Bình province, surrounded by rivers and breathtaking views. ⁠

These rowing boats are driving by incredible strong women that occasionally tell stories about the lush greenery and the lost temples along the river. The smell of incense and the foggy mountains adds a certain mystery and uniqueness to the boat ride. Hang Mua (Dancing Caves) gives, to the those who dare to climb more than 500 steps, a stunning, breathtaking panorama view of mountainside."⁠
⁠
#passionpassport #vietnam #travel".

1,129 likes, 15 comments - passionpassport on April 11, 2022: "Join us on an unforgettable hike through Johnston Canyon!

Carved into the limestone by thousands of years of erosion, Johnston Canyon is absolutely breathtaking. Overhanging canyon walls, waterfalls, the deep ink pot spring pools, and lush forest are sure to leave a memorable impression on visitors. 

#passionpassport #canada #banff".
